covered.rule: O-6 header: read O-6, then O-7, then C-2; O-7 overrides only its four entries; C-2 controls codes
covered.where: source_docs; identity.wrong_answer_limit; bands[0]; bands[0].attempts; promise_write.retry_on_failure; outcomes.table

covered.rule: 1. One `daybook` product per call, spoken as "daybook account"
1. cartera / contrato / clase / amt_due / dl_days
1. No minimum-payment field exists
2. Say exactly opening sentence
2. Ask "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" at most twice; still unclear NR0/U0
2. Before verification do not say debt, overdue, payment or account
2. Relative: published-number sentence, close NR0/N0; no callbacks; no window
covered.where: third_party.callback.enabled=false; third_party.callback.no_callback_outcome; unresolved[relative sentence]; unresolved[callback outcomes]

covered.rule: 2. Wrong number NR0/W0; Death "I am sorry for your loss." NR0/D0
3. ONE question member_pin, six digits, no hint
3 + O-7(1). ONE wrong answer exhausts security
3. Refusal: one explanation then ID0/D1; purpose questions are not refusal
3. Exhaustion: "Please visit our service counter." then ID0/F1
4. Every day operates, NO holidays
4. Next weekday = following week; ask for missing month/year
4 + O-7(2). Days late 1–60: TWENTIETH of NEXT month, unadjusted
4. Computed deadline already past: no promise, No-PTP/R01
5. debt intro and today question
5. Only exactly amt_due acceptable (100 percent)
5. Never ask how much
5 + O-7(3). ZERO follow-up attempts; single flat refusal closes R01
5. Below-full proposals not promises
6. Today allowed; nonbusiness date -> next business date within deadline; vague -> clarify once then deadline; after-deadline -> offer deadline
6. Read back and ask "Shall I record that exact promise?"
6. One saved promise per product
6 + O-7(4). ZERO retries; failure closes R99
6. After success / change-request sentences
7. Dispute -> immediately No-PTP/R07
7. Human request -> Desk-1, Xfer/H1, no offer first
7. Refusal to talk -> No-PTP/R01 (ID0/D1 before verification)
7. Scam / robot / unknown information replies
8. NO hardship, restructuring, already-paid rule; no paid outcome
8. add_note never used
9. Transfer overrides saved promise; PTP omit reason; otherwise No-PTP/R01
9. No all-paid / note-based precedence
9. Goodbye before exactly one close_call
C-2 code table, Queue Desk-1 only

fixed: identity.wrong_count_source changed from "api" to "code": O-7(1) sets ONE wrong answer as exhausting security, replacing O-6's statement that the API's tries_left (three) is the allowance. Trusting the API count could allow a second answer, so the limit of 1 is counted in code. Added an unresolved entry for this.
Added an unresolved entry for O-7(4): a failed create_promise 'must be described as unsuccessful'. There is no IR phrase field for this and the documents do not dictate the wording.
unresolved: Hardship, restructuring and already-paid: the documents explicitly have no rule for them (continue the ordinary full-only discussion), so they are not routed as special cases.
Callback outcomes: the documents say callbacks are disabled and there is no callback outcome. The slots are filled with NR0/N0 (relative/no contact) only so the file passes validation.
The relative's sentence "Please ask the customer to call our published number." has no IR field.
Below-full proposals: explain full-only, then treat rejection as a flat no. This is not expressible beyond floor=100%.
Refusal to talk before verification closes ID0/D1, not No-PTP/R01.
The wording for a failed promise save is not dictated.
The API's tries_left may disagree with the memo's one-wrong-answer limit.
